$comment: English texts of data/labyrinth.json (src/engine/overlay.js): the System Labyrinth's levels, rooms, blessings and report sentences, and the Core's Artifacts, their sizes, traits, abilities and words. Each key of the texts keeps the Polish number of variants, as the engine picks one by index. An Artifact's name is "{size} {name}": "Small Fire Artifact".

fight.name: Combat
fight.text: Creatures of the Labyrinth. Win to gain XP and gold.

elite.name: Elite
elite.text: An elite of the Labyrinth. Win to gain Core Shards, gold and a choice of blessings.

treasure.name: Treasure
treasure.text: A System chest, no fight: Core Shards and gold.

spring.name: Spring
spring.text: The spring heals every fighter by {heal}% of max HP.

altar.name: Altar
altar.text: A choice of one of three blessings.

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.text: The System merchant sells healing and a choice of blessings for gold.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.text: The level's guardian. Win to gain an Artifact and a choice of blessings.

keen-eye.name: Keen Eye
keen-eye.text: The character's chance of a critical hit grows by 8 percentage points.

breath.name: Breath of the Labyrinth
breath.text: After every won fight, every fighter still standing regains 10% of max HP.

first-blood.name: First Blood
first-blood.text: The character's first blow that lands in each fight is critical.

vigour.name: Vigour
vigour.text: The character's max HP grows by 20%.

ward.name: System Ward
ward.text: At the start of every fight the character has a ward of 12% of max HP.

mist.name: Mist
mist.text: The character's chance to dodge grows by 6 percentage points.

common-cause.name: Common Cause
common-cause.text: Every fighter deals 8% more damage and has 8% more armour.

blood-tithe.name: Blood Tithe
blood-tithe.text: 8% of the damage the character deals comes back to it as HP.

care.name: Care
care.text: Companions have 20% more max HP and 15% more armour.

fightStart: Out of the Labyrinth's dark come: {enemies}.
eliteStart: The chamber falls silent. Labyrinth elite: {enemies}.
guardianStart: The level's guardian steps out of the dark: {enemies}.
The whole level goes quiet. The guardian comes: {enemies}.
lost: The chamber was not conquered. The Labyrinth ends for today.
defeat: The System leads {target} out of the Labyrinth.
Fight lost. The System leads {target} out of the Labyrinth.
artifact: The guardian leaves an Artifact: {artifact}. It waits in the Core Cache.
treasure: In the System chest: {gold} gold and Core Shards: {shards}.
spring: The spring heals every fighter: +{heal}% of max HP.
hellOpen: The Hellish level opens: creatures twice as strong as on level 3.
dayDone: The Labyrinth conquered to its end. A new one at midnight.
coreOpen: The Core opens. You absorb Artifacts in the Character tab, in the Core.
towerArtifact: The Tower's champion leaves an Artifact: {artifact}. It waits in the Core Cache.

recovery.name: Healing after a fight
recovery.text: +{value}% of the missing HP back after a won exploration fight

lifesteal.name: Lifesteal
lifesteal.text: {value}% of the damage dealt comes back as HP

sure-first.name: Sure Strike
sure-first.text: The character's first blow in a fight always lands.

first-strike.name: First Move
first-strike.text: The character moves first in a fight.

opening-crit.name: Core Edge
opening-crit.text: The character's first blow that lands is critical.

shield.name: Core Ward
shield.text: At the start of a fight the character has a ward of {value}% of max HP.

rally.name: Second Wind
rally.text: Once a fight, when the character's HP falls below {below}% of max HP, it regains {value}% of max HP.
